title: Offer Negotiation Suite
description: Two-tab deterministic tool for compensation negotiation. Tab 1: Negotiation Script Builder — generates anchor/target/floor counter-offer tiers, scripted opening language, lift distribution across user-prioritized levers, and objection-response pairs. Tab 2: Multi-Offer Comparison Matrix — scores up to 6 offers across 12 weighted dimensions with RAG heatmap and ranked recommendation. Entirely user-input; no embedded reference data.
data_vintage: No embedded data; frameworks based on Galinsky anchoring research and Fisher & Ury BATNA model

mcp_tool_definition.name: build_offer_negotiation
mcp_tool_definition.description: Two-mode negotiation tool. Mode 1 (script_builder): given current offer + target + BATNA + style + priorities, returns counter-offer tiers (anchor/target/floor), scripted language, lift distribution, and objection responses. Mode 2 (comparison_matrix): given up to 6 offers + dimension weights, returns weighted ranking, RAG heatmap data, and winner. Deterministic.

regulatory_citations: Galinsky, A. D. (2001) — When What You Don't Know Won't Hurt You: The Role of Anchoring in the First Offer in Negotiations
Fisher, R. & Ury, W. (1981/2011) — Getting to Yes: Negotiating Agreement Without Giving In
Malhotra, D. (2014) — Negotiation Genius: How to Overcome Obstacles and Achieve Brilliant Results
